monsters.name: Slime
monsters.trivia: Adored by all for its flexy physique and funny face, this little monster is something of an icon. Who wouldn't want one for a pal?

monsters.name: Wing Slime
monsters.trivia: Slimes which sprouted wings aftrer dreaming of soaring through the sky. Their wings double up as a snug sleeping bag at night.

monsters.name: Bubble Slime
monsters.trivia: These unfortunate creatures were once normal slimes until permeated by swamp poison, causing their bodies to collapse like underbaked meringue.

monsters.name: Healslime
monsters.trivia: These soft-centred slimes simply cannot stand by when they spy someone in need. Word has it there's one in particular who travels far and wide in pursuit of his dreams of becoming human.

monsters.name: She-Slime
monsters.trivia: These slimes are proud of their quirky colouration, which is likely the product of a genetic fluke. They feel faintly warm to the touch.

monsters.name: Dragonthorn
monsters.trivia: Cursed thickets of thorn tangled into draconic shape. Those entwine in their terrifying clutches have no hope of escape.

monsters.name: Komodo
monsters.trivia: Nippy little dragons who have learned to stand on their highly-developed hind legs. At full pelt, they can outpace a racehorse, but haven't yet mastered the subtle art of slowing down.

monsters.name: Airbagon
monsters.trivia: Dragons who love giving humans a good fright by inflating themselves and then making themselves burst. In order to get the biggest bang they can, they inhale huge volumes of air but occasionally wimp out before they pop.

monsters.name: Vegandragora
monsters.trivia: Dragons which live in harmony with herbs and flowers. Theey love nothing more than basking in the sun and will get together to lap up the sun's rays on summer days.

monsters.name: Damselfly
monsters.trivia: These dragons  like to ensorcell travellers with their beautiful fairy wings. Not only bewitching to behold, their wings release a fine powder which puts their prey in a trance.

monsters.name: Stark Raven
monsters.trivia: These creepy corvids can't resist scooping up skulls from ancient battlefields. Fledgling ravens like to clamber through the eye-holes to hide from predators.

monsters.name: Bantamweight
monsters.trivia: These thumping great chickens have learned how to fly. Thanks to their highly-developed flight muscles, they can strike with the power of trained puglist.

monsters.name: Killerpillar
monsters.trivia: Though these creepy-crawlies might look like larvae, they are in fact fully grown. They keep themselves warm in cold weather by rolling up into snug little balls.

monsters.name: Capsichum
monsters.trivia: These terrible twins are in fact born already skewered. Always butting heads, they are often witnessed mid-argument.

monsters.name: Mad Mollusk
monsters.trivia: These monsters have two mouths, one at each end. The one at the front is a strict vegetarian, while the one on the tail is meat mad.

monsters.name: Woebergine
monsters.trivia: These adorable vegetable-based monsters are proud of their ability to cut some rug. Any travaeller straying into their terrain should be prepared to see them strut their stuff.

monsters.name: Khalamari Kid
monsters.trivia: These squid-like squirts are baby khalamari. Though small in stature, they're as tough as any full-grown sea-dweller.

monsters.name: Toady
monsters.trivia: These ample amphibians might have mutated into mega-sized monsters, but they retain their original love for croaking out a tune. They like to put on evening concerts just after the rain lets up.

monsters.name: Cyclown
monsters.trivia: These wicked wing spirits sport their whirlwinds like work attire. Their greatest desire is to welcome wanders into their whirling worlds.

monsters.name: Antguzzler
monsters.trivia: These long-snouted  monsters resemble spiny anteaters. Their lengthy tongues are well-adapted to slurping army ants up from their nests.

monsters.name: Mischievous Mole
monsters.trivia: These tunnelling tykes traditionally loved to play pranks, but these days tend to keep their heads down and focus on digging.

monsters.name: Bunicorn
monsters.trivia: These creatures might resemble rabbits, but meet one of their horns head-on and you'll understand the difference rather sharpish. They pass the long nights huddled together in their warrens.

monsters.name: Feralball
monsters.trivia: This fluffball is covered in green fur from top to toe. Though easily spooked, those with sharp eyes might spot something funny where this beastie's nose should be before it scrapers.

monsters.name: Lampling
monsters.trivia: These sparky spirits inhabit lanterns that have been discarded by their owners. They like to terrify unfortunate adventurers who tramp their terrain at night.

monsters.name: Foo Dog
monsters.trivia: Hellish hounds employed in the underworld as ghastly guard dogs. Bloodthirsty to the bone, even fellow monsters give these mutts a wide berth.

monsters.name: Bongo Drongo
monsters.trivia: Sturdy spirits in the thrall of their large-faced bongos. All manner of monsters are drawn in by their deft drumming, entranced by the intricate rhapsody of rhythm.

monsters.name: Leery Lout
monsters.trivia: These shy scoundrels dish out damage from behind their smirking shields, which are precious family heirlooms, passed down from father to son.

monsters.name: Dracky
monsters.trivia: These flapping pains in the neck only come out at night. They love nothing more than slurping up human blood, the fresher the better.

monsters.name: Lunatick
monsters.trivia: These curious monsters' enormous eyeballs afford them excellent vision, even in absolute darkness. Once they set their sights on their prey, they will not give up until they wrap their tentacles around it.

monsters.name: Teeny Sanguini
monsters.trivia: Baby monsters known for their distinctive bovine markings. Considered to be fully-grown once the black fur grows out, replaced entirely with a ravishing shade of rose pink.

monsters.name: Lips
monsters.trivia: Who could resist that king-sized kisser? Protective of their prime assets, you won't catch one of these full-lipped fiends without their trusty lip balm.

monsters.name: Putrefido
monsters.trivia: These cadaverous canines originally died of exhaustion before being brought back to life by the powers of darkness, though any smarts they had are long gone.

monsters.name: Funghoul
monsters.trivia: These great big gurning mushrooms spring up in their dozens in damp locales. They propagate by putting travellers to sleep and seeding them with their spores.

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.trivia: Recycled from the bodies of fallen warriors, these unfortunate cadavers truly get worked to the bone.

monsters.name: Stump Chump
monsters.trivia: The tragic remains of chopped-down trees whose deep-seated malice has made them morph into monsters. They attack travellers who try to sit on them, sucking out all their nutrients before discarding the husk.

monsters.name: Ghost
monsters.trivia: Unfinished business in their previous lives prevents these poltergeists from ever being at peace. They're always trying to inflict to a fright one way or another, just for the attention.

monsters.name: Firespirit
monsters.trivia: No-one knows for certain how these monsters came to be. Some believe they were born of the fiery 'Frizz' spell, while others thing they are the soulds of those who died with a burning desire for revenge.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.trivia: These monsters are said to have been born in the depths of an unfathomably deep darkness. Adept at imitation, they can even forget their natural appearance if they spend long enough shadowing someone else.

monsters.name: Triple Splatty
monsters.trivia: The ripe tomato slime, juicy burger slime and lightly toasted bun slime are a match made in slime heaven. They might look like a tempting meal in waiting, but they don't appreciate being bitten.

items.desc: Slightly increases attack and adds effects of the Crafty Cragger trait.

items.name: Demon's Ring
items.desc: Increases attack (+30) and agility (+30), and raises the likelihood of performing critical hits (Critical Favourite trait).

items.desc: Slightly increases attack (+15), agility (+15) and max. HP (+15).

items.name: Hero's Cloak
items.desc: Increases max. HP (+30) very slightly increases attack (+10) and defence (+10). Also improves resistance to explosions (Bang Ward), ice (Crack Ward) and fire (Frizz Ward).

items.desc: Very slightly increases agility (+10), wisdom (+10) and max. MP (+10).

items.desc: Restores 30 HP to a single ally.

items.desc: Slightly increases defence (+10) and improves resistance to light (Sizz Ward trait).

items.desc: Slightly increases attack and adds effects of the Crafty Sizzer trait.

items.desc: A pongy deposit that can be pitched at one's opponents. Inflicts minor damage to a single enemy when used in battle.

items.name: Monster Munchies

items.desc: Cures a single ally of paralysis.

items.desc: Suspicious meat of unknown origin. Feed to a monster to increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you by a random factor.

items.desc: Slightly increases agility (+15), wisdom (+15) and max. MP (+15).

items.name: Rarified Steak
items.desc: Odd offcuts, the origin of which amy never be ascertained. Feed to a mosnter to increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you by a random factor. Occasionally inflicts a status ailment.

items.name: Red Travelite
items.desc: A red crystal that was forged by the ancient elves. It contains a magical energy that allows travel to previously inaccessible areas of Nadiria.

items.name: Rockbomb Shard
items.desc: An unstable stone that explodes when it strikes its target. Almost kills a single enemy when used in battle, but the damage it inflicts will vary according to the target's resistance to instance death.

items.name: Rubber Amulet
items.desc: Slightly increases defence (+10) and improves resistance to electricity (Zap Ward trait).

items.name: Rubber Belt
items.desc: Slightly increases attack and adds effects of the Crafty Zapper trait.

items.desc: Slightly improves the likehlihood of acquiring items (Scavenger = Unknown) after defeating an enemy.

items.name: Scavenger's Medal
items.desc: Improves the likehlihood of acquiring items (Hoarder = Unknown) after defeating an enemy.

items.name: Scout's Badge
items.desc: Improves the likelihood of a show of Force succeeding

items.name: Scuba Earrings
items.desc: Slightly increase defence (+10) and improve resistance to water (Splish Ward trait) and dark (Zam Ward trait).

items.name: Seed of Agility
items.desc: Raises the agility of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its agility that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seed of Life
items.desc: Raises the max. HP of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its max. HP that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seed of Magic
items.desc: Raises the max. MP of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its max. MP that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seed of Resilience
items.desc: Raises the defence of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its defence that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seed of Skill
items.desc: Provides a single ally with 3 additional talent points. Note that a monster can have a maximum of 999 available talent points.

items.name: Seed of Strength
items.desc: Raises the attack of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster type has an upper limit to its attack that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seed of Wisdom
items.desc: Raises the wisdom of a single ally by 3. Note that each monster has an upper limit to its wisdom that cannot be exceeded.

items.name: Seer's Ring+

items.desc: A tender treat that monsters adore. Feed to a monster to slightly increase the likelihood of it wanting to join you.

items.desc: Very slightly increases defence (+10), agility (+10) and max. HP (+10).

items.desc: Restores 60 HP to a single ally.

items.desc: Increases the amount of experience earned (Wealth of Experience = +0.5x).
